notes.title: No More Giants Announcement
notes.content:
Developer Thoughts
What an incredible journey the past year has been. Looking back, it's awesome to see the strides made on our debut game that started so small. I'm thrilled to share the No more Giants announcement trailer, a rebrand, and the next milestone we are aiming for. First things first...

No More Giants Announcement Trailer
With the excitement surrounding gaming this month (along with the impending January lull), we have our first trailer to show. Experience first person action as you fight off The Inventors in a land once shepherd by Ancient Giants. Get your first look at special player abilities known as bionics (inspired by Bioshock), as well as your first look at the Coalition, a military crew gunning for something powerful. Stick around for a special tease at what's ahead on your journey. 

[previewyoutube=qfQYWIro0mU;full][/previewyoutube]

A Refreshing Rebrand
Progressing through many different concepts helped informed the elements that felt right at home. With a mix of action, story, and mystical elements, it became clear that the game had outgrown the previous logo, name, and look. Below are some of the key areas that have been overhauled or changed. 

New Name
Isle of Rein is now No More Giants. 

New Look
With an emphasis on atmosphere and the mystical giants, it felt fitting that we drive these two elements home in a beautiful art piece by @adreamteller (Instagram), which helps inform our other brand assets. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42480691/7e9c98fe1f9cfa027149dbcdd0c5853cc51f439a.png

Bionic Abilities
Explore valleys, mountains, and different biomes to unlock new abilities known as Bionics. Bionics affect both objects & enemies, and can help you solve problems in creative ways. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42480691/e366663a3ff04db014db943bbc7baa0147c1bf48.gif

What is next for No More Giants?
With our announcement trailer & rebrand launched, we are shifting focus to a playable demo that offers players a bite-sized piece of what makes this game special. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42480691/476ac49888626b938976156a9ef0de79deb00772.gif
